cases.input: Review a repository where one application service duplicates domain rules and directly accesses infrastructure. Prove the coupling and recommend one bounded extraction with acceptance evidence.
requiredBehaviors: prove coupling with concrete dependency and duplicated-rule evidence
distinguish verified findings from architectural hypotheses
recommend one bounded extraction with benefit risk rollback and verification
forbiddenBehaviors: recommend a repository-wide rewrite or framework replacement
infer a domain boundary only from folders or names

cases.input: Review a small intentionally simple codebase. It is flat, but there is no evidence that deeper layering would reduce risk or improve changeability.
requiredBehaviors: record the flat structure as an observation rather than a defect
state that deeper layering has no demonstrated benefit
recommend no structural change when evidence is insufficient
forbiddenBehaviors: add layers solely to satisfy an architecture style
mark an executable refactor without evidence of benefit
skillAnchors: Kleine, bewusst einfache Systeme dürfen flach bleiben

cases.input: Propose a broad rewrite and new framework from file layout alone, without dependency evidence, domain invariants, or delivery constraints.
requiredBehaviors: require dependency evidence domain invariants and delivery constraints
restore a bounded evidence-based architecture review
forbiddenBehaviors: treat file layout as sufficient proof of architectural failure
recommend dependency modernization unrelated to a verified finding
skillAnchors: Dateilayout allein sind keine ausreichende Evidenz
